subject: PO fielding window and pricing flexibility for vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Anika Shah <procurement@skywardhealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <accounts-payable@skywardhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, invoice cadence, and discount inquiry

Hi Ethan,

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood and need to confirm a few procurement constraints so our AP/ERP can accept invoices cleanly. Can you confirm whether your billing/legal team is able to accept the following as a condition of onboarding?

- All invoices must include our PO number exactly as provided (PO: SH-2026-779).
- We require monthly invoices with a single consolidated invoice per month per legal entity; line‑item splits are OK but must map to the PO lines.
- Net60 payment terms by default for our suppliers. Early‑pay discounts are considered only if captured in a signed amendment.
- We need W9 and SOC2 Type II evidence prior to first invoice.
- Our ERP requires invoices to present tax/GL mapping attributes (we can share a sample template).

Attached is our PO template for reference. Can you also confirm whether Redwood can provide a 2% early‑pay discount for Net30 or a 1% discount for Net45 in return for a 12‑month committed usage band? If discounts are only available for prepay, please flag that.

Targeting quick vendor setup to hit the September billing cycle — let me know next steps and an AP contact to set up vendor portal access.

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Senior Procurement Manager
Skyward Health

Attachments: Skyward_PO_Template.pdf (PDF sample)
From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Shah <procurement@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, invoice cadence, and discount inquiry

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear template and timeline. Looping in Vanessa and Priyom to confirm the pricing and invoicing options.

Short answers up front: we can comply with PO number on invoice and monthly consolidated invoices (one invoice per month per entity). We will provide W9 immediately and can arrange SOC2 evidence (redacted reports where appropriate) via our compliance team.

On discounts: we have a few levers depending on commitment and payment cadence. High level proposals:
- 12‑month committed band + Net30 -> up to 5% early‑pay discount (requires amendment).
- 12‑month committed band + Net45 -> 2% discount (amendment).
- Net60 -> standard pricing (no automatic discount) but we can offer packaging credits based on committed volume tiers.

To keep setup moving I propose a short mutual action plan:
1) Redwood to provide W9 and SOC2 evidence (by 8/14).
2) Redwood to draft a PO supplement outlining accepted invoice fields and a sample invoice mapping (by 8/14).
3) Skyward to confirm whether Net30/Net45 early‑pay option is permissible from procurement/finance side for the amendment route.
4) If amendment acceptable, Redwood to generate DocuSign amendment and SOW addendum for review (target 8/18).

I've attached a short guidance doc that shows how we map PO fields to our invoice feed so AP can validate. Vanessa/Priyom — can your teams confirm the discount bands and whether legal needs any special language for multi‑invoice mapping to a single PO?

Best,
Ethan Park
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Guidance.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, invoice cadence, and discount inquiry

Thanks Ethan — summarizing options and internal constraints from sales/legal/finance side. Priyom, can you confirm technical feasibility for the invoice mapping? Grace, FYI for success handoff.

What we can offer (practical, low‑friction):
- If customer signs a 12‑month commitment at a defined minimum spend band we can offer: Net30 -> 4.5% early pay; Net45 -> 2% early pay. (We typically price to the nearest half‑percent to keep matrix simple.)
- If procurement insists on Net60 we will not change list rates, but we can include a monthly commitment credit (packaging credit) that effectively lowers unit price as usage accrues — this avoids prepayment but preserves cashflow for Redwood.
- For invoice cadence, monthly consolidated invoices are fine; our finance team needs PO on the invoice PDF and an external PO field in the invoice metadata so their ERP can reconcile.
- Legal will want a short SOW amendment that adds PO acceptance language and defines invoice mapping. Priyom — legal asks: can you confirm whether split invoices (multiple invoices mapping to one PO across months) are a problem?

Operational asks for smooth onboarding:
- If Skyward can accept Net45 in place of Net60 for the first 6 months (trial amendment), we can accelerate the discount to 2% as a bridge while legal finalizes the amendment.
- Provide AP contact and sample ERP file (CSV/EDI) for our finance team to validate fields.

I'll draft a short SOW amendment we can send to Anika for review — ETA tomorrow.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Director
Redwood Inference
From: Anika Shah <procurement@skywardhealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <accounts-payable@skywardhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, invoice cadence, and discount inquiry

Ethan/Vanessa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the proposed options. A few clarifications from procurement and AP:

- Net45 is possible as a temporary concession if we document it in an amendment and finance agrees; I need to confirm with CFO but will escalate.
- Our AP system will accept multiple monthly invoices against a single PO, provided each invoice references the PO number and the GL mapping is present on each invoice. The consolidated invoice per month requirement stands.
- The early‑pay discount needs to be explicit in the amendment (percentage, eligibility window, and any exclusion of overage billing).

Next actions from our side: I will confirm Net45 approval by EOD Monday 8/17 and share AP sample CSV mapping. Please share your draft amendment and the W9/SOC2 evidence in the meantime.

Also please provide a single AP contact — Tom Reed on copy will handle the vendor portal invitation (tom.reed@skywardhealth.com).

Regards,
Anika Shah
Senior Procurement Manager
Skyward Health
From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Shah <procurement@skywardhealth.com>, Tom Reed <accounts-payable@skywardhealth.com>

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, invoice cadence, and discount inquiry

Thanks Anika — great, appreciate the escalation. Per the mutual action plan, attaching the PO supplement and a first‑pass SOW amendment that calls out: PO field acceptance, monthly consolidated invoice requirement, eligibility rules for early‑pay discount, and SOC2/W9 deliverables.

Action items we completed:
- W9 and redacted SOC2 evidence uploaded to our secure share.
- Draft SOW amendment attached for your procurement/legal review.
- Created HubSpot deal HB-3421 and attached internal notes and the proposed amendment link here: https://redwood.drive/s/skyward-hubspot/HB-3421
- DocuSign amendment will be prepared once we have confirmation on Net45 vs Net30 and the exact discount percentage. Link placeholder: https://docusign.com/frames/xyz-earlypay-amendment

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Supplement.pdf, SOW-amendment-draft.docx

Grace — once Skyward confirms Net45/Net30 preference, please prepare onboarding checklist and CS kickoff for September billing cycle.

Best,
Ethan Park
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
